flags.why: The meaning 'great; big' applies specifically to waves, not to size or greatness generally ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%E1%BB%ABng)).
Lừng lẫy in this example means glorious or resounding and illustrates sense 1 rather than the wave-related sense ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%E1%BB%ABng)).
A learner is more likely to encounter the internal-injury meaning than the specialist domestic-trade meaning.
Phóng uế includes both urinating and defecating in an inappropriate place, including indoors ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ph%C3%B3ng_u%E1%BA%BF)).
flags.fix: to urinate or defecate in an inappropriate place

flags.why: The prohibition covers urination as well as defecation, whereas the English translation mentions only defecation ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ph%C3%B3ng_u%E1%BA%BF)).
flags.fix: Urinating or defecating indiscriminately in public places is forbidden.
